evidence: The nanolaminate was formed by repeating a cycle in which M monolayers of TiO2 were deposited, followed by a single monolayer of SiO2. To deposit a TiO2 monolayer, water was introduced into the chamber for 2 s, followed by a 2 s nitrogen purge. Then Ti ethaoxide was introduced into the chamber, followed by another 2 s nitrogen purge. SiO2 monolayers were deposited by introducing water into the ALD chamber for 1 s, followed by a 2 s nitrogen purge. Silanol was then introduced for 1 s.
